# Avera

> Avera is a digital marketing and web development studio based in Bengaluru, India, founded by Aswin Krishnan. Avera designs, builds, and manages websites, e-commerce stores, SEO, and digital marketing campaigns for growing businesses.

## Services
- Web Design & Development — responsive marketing sites and web apps
- E-commerce Development — Shopify, WooCommerce, and custom storefronts
- SEO — technical audits, on-page fixes, content strategy, link building
- Digital Marketing — paid search, social campaigns, content marketing
- Website Management — updates, backups, uptime monitoring, security
- Analytics & Reporting — dashboards for traffic, conversion, campaigns

## Pricing (indicative, INR)
- Launch: one-time website build package
- Growth: monthly retainer covering SEO, management, and updates
- Scale: custom scope for e-commerce or multi-site businesses with dedicated marketing support
